description: This file defines the main dashboard page component (`HomePage`) for a KeystoneJS admin UI, including subcomponents like `ListCard` and `CardLink`. It fetches list counts via GraphQL, displays a grid of list cards with navigation links and create buttons, and handles error display.

methods.name: ListCard
methods.description: Component that renders a card for a specific list, including its label, count, and optional create button.

methods.name: CardLink
methods.description: Wrapper component for navigation links with styling and focus management.
